message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src/bin/fuzz/config_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":43,"var":"data/size","code":"memcpy(static_data, data, size);","note":"The fuzz target copies attacker-controlled bytes into a mutable buffer."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_open_for_fuzzing","line":789,"var":"len","code":"return config_init_data(config, data, len - 1);","note":"The copied bytes are passed to the config parser as the exact parse span."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_init_data","line":805,"var":"lexer.pos/end","code":".pos = data, .start = data, .end = (char *)data + len,","note":"The lexer boundaries are derived from the attacker-controlled length, so the parser can advance to the final byte of the input."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_config","line":459,"var":"chr","code":"if (chr == '\'' && !strncmp(lexer->pos, "''", 2)) return lex_multiline_string;","note":"Inputs beginning with triple quotes transition into multiline-string scanning."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string","line":342,"var":"end","code":"char *end = (peek(lexer) == '\"') ? \"\"\"\" : \"'''\";","note":"The code selects a 3-byte terminator based on the third attacker-controlled quote character."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string","line":345,"var":"lexer->pos","code":"if (!strncmp(lexer->pos, end, 3)) {","note":"The loop compares three bytes at lexer->pos against the closing delimiter; if lexer->pos is positioned at the last one or two bytes of the input, this comparison can read past the mapped buffer and trigger ASAN."}
]
p.write_text('[\n' + ',\n'.join(__import__('json').dumps(x) for x in trace) + '\n]')
print(p.read_text())
PY
